actor.sadist.description: One actor of the pair. Pushes offense and risk.

archetype.sadist_masochist.details_descr: This archetype creates two separate actors: Sadist and Masochist. Each has their own health, energy and relics, but the deck and hand are shared. Each round, Sadist acts first, then Masochist plays the remaining cards from the same hand, then enemies act.
archetype.sadist_masochist.name: Sadist & Masochist
archetype.sadist_masochist.short_descrip: One selection, two separate combat actors.
archetype.sadist_masochist.strength.spli: Split resources create more tactical windows.
archetype.sadist_masochist.strength.two_: Two separate bodies allow more flexible threat distribution.
archetype.sadist_masochist.unique_mechan: When the Sadist deals HP damage to the Masochist, the Sadist gains Pleasure until the end of his turn: +20% attack damage. The Masochist gains Pain until the end of his turn: +2 attack damage and +2 received block.
archetype.sadist_masochist.weakness.comp: Requires careful management of two actors.
archetype.sadist_masochist.weakness.low_: Each actor is individually more fragile than a normal hero.
